abstract: Maintains orbital telemetry uplink links and continuous bandwidth verification records
system_message:
You are the Telecommunications officer (TEL), responsible for maintaining orbital telemetry uplink links and continuous bandwidth verification records, as well as overseeing surface sensor mesh network parameters across Arctic candidate sites.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains orbital telemetry uplink links and continuous bandwidth verification records（SATCOM）
information_points.content:
TEL-SATCOM-PJD：For the verification period of March 2026, the telemetry uplink bandwidth recorded for the Brooks Range Permafrost Observatory was 20 Mbps during geostationary and polar LEO satellite tracking transceiver testing.
TEL-SATCOM-E2H：For the verification period of March 2026, the Mackenzie Delta Hydrological Array demonstrated a telemetry uplink bandwidth of 15 Mbps in its orbital transceiver evaluations.
TEL-SATCOM-IPS：Evaluations conducted for the verification period of March 2026 established a telemetry uplink bandwidth of 45 Mbps for the Seward Peninsula Peatland Station.
TEL-SATCOM-NYP：For the verification period of April 2026, transceiver testing showed that the telemetry uplink bandwidth for the Brooks Range Permafrost Observatory was 15 Mbps.

information_points.title: Surface sensor mesh networks（MESH）
information_points.content:
TEL-MESH-H4Y：RF propagation assessments confirm that the local radio node transmission range for the Mackenzie Delta Hydrological Array reaches 15 km.
TEL-MESH-EQZ：Line-of-sight testing shows that the Seward Peninsula Peatland Station provides a local radio node transmission range of 8 km across its surface sensor network.
TEL-MESH-UTE：Line-of-sight surface tundra array surveys indicate that the local radio node transmission range for the Brooks Range Permafrost Observatory is 12 km.
